The '''Ferra sector''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], [[Bundil]], and [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]].
